maddeler.e:
أنتور (form VIII)
# أَنْتَوِرُ (ʔantawiru) /ʔan.ta.wi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَوَرَ (intawara)
# أَنْتَوِرَ (ʔantawira) /ʔan.ta.wi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَوَرَ (intawara)
# أَنْتَوِرْ (ʔantawir) /ʔan.ta.wir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَوَرَ (intawara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
